schema.description: OrganizationRolesRequest contains functional roles that can be assigned to users or groups in addition to their base level org role such as member, admin, etc.

group_ids.description: Group IDs to assign the role to

items.description: Group IDs to assign the role to

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization to assign roles in. Defaults to the authenticated organization.

role.description: The organization responsibility role to assign

user_ids.description: User IDs to assign the role to

items.description: User IDs to assign the role to

schema.title: OrganizationRolesRequest
